rules.statement: The court may expunge objectionable matter from the record where the observations are general and sweeping in their nature, unjustified by the evidence in the record and unnecessary for the decision of the case and are damaging to the character and reputation of the aggrieved person.
rules.supporting_quote: This Court would more readily expunge objectionable matter from the record where the observations are general and sweeping in their nature, unjustified by the evidence in the record and unnecessary for the decision of the case and are damaging to the character and reputation of the aggrieved person.

meta.parties: L.C.Fernando v. The Republic of Sri Lanka
